paite: Hiai thil nung in van a kipan angel dang, thuneihna liantak nei, van a kipan hong paikhesuk ka mu a; athupina in leitung avaksak hi.
heading: Babulon Pukna
english: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.

paite: Aw ngaihtak in akikou a, "Chimta, chimta Babulon khopi thupi, dawite omna leh kha nin tengteng kulh leh vasa nin leh huathuai teng kulh ahong hita hi.
english: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hated bird!

paite: Nam tengteng in amingaihna hehna uain a nam tengteng dawnkhamsak a-om ua, leitung Kumpipate'n amah akingaihpih ua, leitung sumsinte noptal luatna a ahong hauh tak ziak un," achi hi.
english: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”

paite: Huan van a kipan in aw dang in hichibang in agen hi: "Ka mite akhelhna ua na pan khaklouhna ding uh leh ahii na kailouhna ding un, amah a kipan in hong paikhia un, achih ka za hi.
english: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,

paite: Akhelhna van atungta a, Pathian in akhelhnate atheigige hi.
english: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.

paite: Ama'n hon piak bangmah akiang ah pia unla, amah gamtatna aleh nih in thukkik un; ahelna nou ah amah a ding in aleh nih in helsak un,
english: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.

paite: Akithupisakna zahzah leh anoptalna zah in amah bawlgim un, hihlungkham un; ama'n alungsim a, 'Kumpinu in ka tu a, meithai ka hi kei, bangchi mah in ka lungkham ngei kei ding,' achih ziak in.
english: However much she glorified herself and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’

paite: Huaiziak in ni khat sung in hipi a gawtna, sihna, lungkhamna leh kialna ahong tung ding hi; huan amah mei in halmang vek in om in teh; atung a vaihawm Toupa Pathian ahat ziak in."
english: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire, for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.

paite: Huan leitung a kumpipate amah kingaihpih leh nuamtat a omte'n, amah haltumna meikhu amuh chiang un, amah kah in amau ding uhi.
english: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,

paite: Athuakna a hihnat a om ding lau in gamlapi a dingh in, "Maizen! Maizen! Khopi thupi Babilon! Dakkal khat sung a na tung a vaihawmna ahong tung ngal a," achi ding uhi.
english: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’

paite: Huan leitung a sumsinte'n, asumsinna van uh kuamah in alei louh ziak un, kap in asuun ding uhi.
english: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more:

paite: Huan asumsinna vante uh dangka-eng leh dangka a sumsinna van, suangmantam, tuikepsuang, puanmalngat hoih, puansan, maimom puan, puan eng, singnamtui, saiha a bawl van, sing mantampen chi a van bawl tengteng, sumsan leh sik leh marbul suang a belsuan bawl tengteng;
english: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;

paite: leh singguithak, namtui, namtui haichi, thaunamtui, chim, uain, thau, buhnel, buh, belam, huan sakol kangtalai leh sal, huai tuh mite hinna ahi.
english: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.

paite: "Huan na lungsim a na deih gahte'n nang hon taimangsan ua, thil limchi leh hoih teng in nang ahon manthatsan ua, muh nawn ahi ngei kei ding," achi uhi.
english: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you. All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.

paite: Hiai thilte a sumsinte, amah ziak a hau a bawlte'n, amah hihnat a a-omna lau in gamlapi a dingh in, kap in asuun ding uhi.
english: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,

paite: “Maizen! Maizen! Khopi thupi, puanmalngat hoih, asan leh a-eng a kizem a, dangka-eng, suangmantam leh tuikepsuang a kivannu!
english: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!

paite: Dakkal khat in hichi tel a hauhna thupi bangmah lou a bawl a a-om ziak in,” achi ding uhi. Huan longpute leh akoilam lam a long a hong tungte leh long mite leh tuipi a nek zong tengteng gamlapi ah adingh uhi.
english: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,

paite: Amau khopi kang leh halna meikhu amuh chiang un, "Hiai bang kho thupi a-om ngei hiam," chi in akikou uhi.
english: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’

paite: Huan alutung ua leivui kibuak in akikou ua, kap leh suun in, "Maizen! Maizen! Kho thupi huai a tuipi a mi longnei tengteng ama hauhsakna ziak a hauhsak in a-om uhi! Dakkal khat sung a amah bangmah lou ahong hih tak mai, achi ding uhi.
english: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For she is made desolate in one hour.

paite: "Aw nang van, amah tung ah kipak unla, Aw nou misiangthoute leh nou sawltakte leh nou zawlneite; na tung ua avaihawmna Pathian in ama tung a vai ahawm tak ziak in kipak un!" achi uhi.
english: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets, for God has judged your judgment on her.”

paite: Huan angel hat khat in buhgawina suang lianpi hileh kilawm suang khat adom a, tuipi ah apailut a, "Hichibang in khopi thupi, Babulon nakpi a hihchip in om in chin, muhkhiak nawn louh hial in a-om ding.
english: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.

paite: Gosem tumte leh lasiamte leh tamngai tumte leh pengkul tumte, na sung ah akiza nawn kei hial ding hi. Khutsiam siamna nei himhim, na sung ah muhkhiak in om nawn kei hial un chin; na sung ah khawl ging akiza nawn sam kei ding hi.
english: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman of whatever craft will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.

paite: Na sung ah meivak avak nawn kei ding a; mouneipa aw leh mou aw na sung ah akiza nawn kei ding; na sumsinte lah leitung kumpipate ahi ngal ua; na bumsiamna in nam tengteng khem in a-omta uhi!
english: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you, for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.

paite: "Amah sung ah zawlneite sisan leh misiangthoute sisan leh leitung a thah a omte tengteng sisan akimukhia hi," achi hi.
english: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”
